title: Storyline Day 3: Caldera Agent Deployment & GOAD Active Directory Discovery
description: Detects Day 3 of the 7-day multi-pillar adversary storyline: Caldera Sandcat agent deployment (splunkd.exe) on GOAD-DC01 (kingslanding), GOAD-DC02 (winterfell), and GOAD-SRV02 (castelblack) followed by AdFind LDAP enumeration and SharpHound BloodHound collection.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and ('Host Name (Server)' in ('kingslanding', 'winterfell', 'castelblack') or Entity in ('kingslanding', 'winterfell', 'castelblack')) and ('Command Line' like '*splunkd.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*AdFind*' or 'Command Line' like '*SharpHound*') | stats count as discovery_events, distinctcount('Process Name') as tools_observed by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Process Name' | sort -discovery_events
falsepositives: Legitimate Splunk Universal Forwarder binaries installed under C:\Program Files\SplunkUniversalForwarder\bin\
investigation_notes: Inspect C:\Users\Public\splunkd.exe command line arguments for Caldera C2 server URLs (-server http://192.168.100.78:8888).
Correlate AdFind and SharpHound execution timestamps across kingslanding, winterfell, and castelblack.
